The '''Teirasans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that originated in the [[Teirasa system/Legends|Teirasa system]]<ref name="EGTW" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the Republic, which at the time was under the control of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] cult, launched the [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade]] against both the Teirasans and the [[Zarracine]]s of the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]] in [[11,660 BBY]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] advanced toward the Teirasa system.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Teirasans were introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
